fluff.overview: The Word of Blake Militia inherited ComStar's combined-arms organizational philosophy and its Star League-era equipment stocks, fielding infantry formations that ranked among the best equipped in the Inner Sphere during the Jihad. Mechanized tracked Level I formations rode APCs that could keep pace with armor across broken terrain, providing the all-terrain mobility and armor protection that garrison duty on undeveloped worlds demanded. The tracked transport kept these troops mobile even on worlds where roads were poor or nonexistent. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
